unresolved_items: Currentness must be reviewed against SRC-0043 before publication of a complete current Article 27 note.

evidence_candidates.claim: Before deployment, Article 27(1) requires a deployer-side fundamental-rights impact assessment for high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2), except systems intended for the Annex III point 2 area, when the deployer is a public-law body, a private entity providing public services, or a deployer of the Annex III point 5(b) or 5(c) systems.
qualifiers: The actor categories, Article 6(2) route and Annex III point 2 exclusion are part of the applicability gate; this candidate does not establish a universal FRIA obligation.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must describe the deployer processes in which the high-risk AI system will be used in accordance with its intended purpose.
qualifiers: The description is tied to the system's intended purpose and the deployer's specific processes.
evidence_candidates.relevance: Required FRIA process and intended-purpose record.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must describe the period during which, and the frequency with which, each high-risk AI system is intended to be used.
qualifiers: The period and frequency are recorded for each system in the deployer's intended use context.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must identify the categories of natural persons and groups likely to be affected by use of the system in the specific context.
qualifiers: Affected categories and groups are context-specific; the candidate does not prescribe a universal taxonomy.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must identify the specific risks of harm likely to affect the persons or groups identified in the specific context, taking account of the information supplied by the provider under Article 13.
qualifiers: The risk description is tied to the affected groups, context and provider information.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must describe how human-oversight measures are implemented in accordance with the instructions for use.
qualifiers: The candidate requires description of implementation; it does not define a single oversight design.

evidence_candidates.claim: The FRIA must describe the measures to take if the identified risks materialise, including internal governance arrangements and internal complaint mechanisms.
qualifiers: The measures address the risks identified in the specific context and include the stated internal governance and complaint elements.

evidence_candidates.claim: The Article 27(1) FRIA obligation applies to the first use of the high-risk AI system.
qualifiers: The first-use rule applies after the Article 27(1) actor and system gate is satisfied.

evidence_candidates.claim: In similar cases, the deployer may rely on previously performed fundamental-rights impact assessments or existing assessments carried out by the provider.
qualifiers: The permission is limited to similar cases and does not remove the deployer's responsibility to assess current applicability.

evidence_candidates.claim: If an element listed in Article 27(1) changes or is no longer up to date during use, the deployer takes the necessary measures to update the information.
qualifiers: The update trigger is tied to change or loss of currency of an Article 27(1) element during use.

evidence_candidates.claim: After completing the FRIA, the deployer notifies the market-surveillance authority of the results and submits the completed model referred to in Article 27(5) as part of that notification.
qualifiers: The notification follows completion of the Article 27(1) assessment and uses the model referred to in Article 27(5).

evidence_candidates.claim: Deployers may be exempt from the Article 27(3) notification obligation in the case referred to in Article 46(1).
qualifiers: The exception is cross-referenced to Article 46(1) and must not be generalized beyond that case.

classification_proposals.basis: Source manifest and prior classification event identify the official AI Act text as BINDING. Currentness remains subject to comparison with the reviewed amending act SRC-0043.
